propositions: Bedrock region resolution ignores AWS_REGION environment variable and only consults REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, causing LLM operations to fail when only AWS_REGION is set

A new pure resolver function must implement the precedence chain REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION > boto3 profile fallback and pass the resolved region explicitly to boto3.session.Session to bypass botocore's AWS_REGION quirk
Provenance recording must capture both the resolved bedrock region and its source (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, AWS_REGION) in provider_provenance when rebar's chain resolves
Empty-string environment variables must be treated as unset to match botocore behavior
Error messages must name the full resolution chain and remove the stale AWS_REGION-does-not-work paragraph
